# ZBattle roadmap
Two phases per batch, then pause for user check-in.
| Phase | Scope | Status | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | AI workspace/recovery | REVIEW | Codex |
| 2 | Android shell, saved master/starter, compact navigation | REVIEW; native verification pending | Codex |
| 3 | Region/location cards and encounters | BACKLOG | ChatGPT UX, Codex code |
| 4 | Turn-based battle vertical slice and save/recovery | BACKLOG | Claude review, Codex code |
| 5 | Skills, tools, equipment, gathering | BACKLOG | Claude |
| 6 | One AFK assignment, capped elapsed progress, idempotent claims | BACKLOG | Claude; independent review |
| 7 | One-way ZPet copy and bounded Legacy Bonus | BACKLOG | Claude protocol, Codex integration |
| 8 | Polish, permanent signing, APK Release, device acceptance | BACKLOG | ChatGPT UX, Codex build |
## Product direction
Separate app; all five cosmetic styles × male/female share skills/equipment. Approved original ZPet creatures.
ZPet → ZBattle copy only; original remains in ZPet. Separate battle progression. No rewards, items, XP or evolution writes back. Stable source pet IDs, once-per-milestone rewards and non-resetting reimports.
Bonus categories proposed: capped starting XP, bond task efficiency, earned evolution availability, cosmetics. Exact balance undecided.
Reference README yamaroni/little-pokemon describes swipeable locations/direct turn-based encounters/no overworld. Repository is deployed Flutter files; no source/assets copied.
## Backlog and bugs
Ten Pet Master illustrations need artwork approval; none generated. No confirmed gameplay bugs; native foundation/layout/save checks pending.
